Frequently Asked Questions

What is the Passes Playbook?

A strategy guide that maps Pass tactics to three stages of the customer lifecycle.

Do I need every Mezzofy product to use these strategies?

No. Every tactic runs on the Mezzofy exchange.

How quickly can I launch a Pass campaign?

Most tactics go live in minutes.

Can I combine tactics across stages?

Yes. The playbook is built to chain.
